blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Soil is composed of four major components: mineral matter, organic matter, water, and air.
Mineral matter forms the largest proportion (45%) and originates from weathered parent rock.
Organic matter, also known as humus, accounts for 5% of soil and comprises decomposed plant and animal remains.
Water and air each occupy 25% of the pore spaces, essential for nutrient transport and supplying oxygen to roots respectively.

items: Exam questions frequently test the specific breakdown of soil volume: 45% mineral, 5% organic, 25% water, and 25% air.
Remember that soil water facilitates nutrient transport, whereas soil air supplies oxygen to roots.
Proportions of soil components are not static; they vary based on climate and location.
